entities.summary: Christos Tapoutos is a Greek former professional basketball player and current basketball executive. At a height of 2.06 m tall, he played at both the small forward and power forward positions, with power forward being his main position. During his early professional years, Tapoutos was considered to be one of the greatest scorers and talents in his age group in all of Europe.
